title: RFC-014: OIDC for Service-to-Service Auth
content:
Status: Accepted.

We will replace SAML for service-to-service flows with OIDC client_credentials grant. Human SSO continues to use SAML against Okta. Rationale: SAML s2s requires bespoke assertion signing per service; OIDC has well-supported client libraries and short-lived bearer tokens. Rollout: Q2 2026, service by service, with a parallel-run period of 14 days each.

title: Design Tokens v3
content: Primary brand color: #1E40AF (Blue 800). Secondary: #0EA5E9 (Sky 500). Body text: #0F172A on #F8FAFC. All tokens exported to Tailwind config and Figma library.

title: Q1 Security Incident Log (Restricted)
content: Findings from the Q1 security review: one S3 bucket was found with overly permissive list permissions. Remediated 2026-02-12. No data exfiltration detected. Two stale IAM users with old access keys revoked. Recommendation: enforce 90-day key rotation in policy.
